findings.text: non-blocking: CensusBeat.stop() joins its thread with no timeout, while every sibling beat in the same file bounds its join (station.py:143, :296, :504); a census pass blocked in the /proc walk therefore holds run_station's finally and delays station shutdown and lease release, where the siblings cap the same wait.

non-blocking: no test asserts the station's finally stops the census thread — deleting lines 890-891 leaves tests/test_the_station_runs_the_census.py green, so the stop half of the wiring has no guard while the start half is guarded by the negative control.

non-blocking: a 'stopping' record is printed for every orphan of the first census before apply_census revalidates identity and disappears the process, so a candidate spared on revalidation logs 'stopping' followed by 'spared', reporting an action that did not happen.

non-blocking: the census thread starts for every station, so the eight pre-existing tests calling run_station now perform a real census against the user's live crew home and can SIGTERM real orphans — tests/test_one_station_per_node_runs_the_tick.py:234 patches only XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, making the suite write outside its repository in the direction the repo rules call dangerous.
